title: Principal-axis Gaussian hybrid
label: Oriented basis
question: Can principal-axis covariance learning improve thin local supports?
method: Return to the EXP-012 hybrid with 384 components per class. Parameterize each covariance by a learned rotation angle and two positive principal widths instead of bounded correlation. Initialize all classes identically using a generic grid, eight orientations and widths 0.12/0.06; retain the compact modulated MLP correction. No shape formulas or target samples enter initialization.
finding: Goal reached: 61/100 passed, improving the previous best 50/100. Mean SW1 is 0.02780. All checkerboards pass and several thin-curve families improve, although waves remain unsuccessful. Parameter count is 8.2% above the 281346 reference; training, data, evaluation and 100-step Heun are unchanged.
